**Changed**

- Added a default-off global PQ shortlist experiment in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs): `VDB_ENABLE_PQ_PRESCORE` now trains compact global PQ codebooks, stores per-vector PQ codes in cluster order, and uses PQ prescoring before the existing `f16` rerank.
- Extended the ANN harness in [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only), [measure_ann_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_benchmark), and [tools/README.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/README.md) with `--enable-pq-prescore`; `measure_ann_search_only` also now has `--prime-build` so local runs can exclude first-search index build from steady-state QPS comparisons.
- Updated the persistent notes in [strategy.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/strategy.md), [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md), and [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md).

**Current Expectation**

- Default scored path is still valid and unchanged in behavior: `build_project` succeeded, `run_correctness_test` passed at `1.0000` recall, and a fresh quick `run_benchmark` measured `7491.12 QPS`. I would treat that quick number as noise; the scored expectation is still roughly low-`10k` to low-`12k`, not a promotion candidate.
- The new PQ branch is promising locally but not yet exact-transfer positive. Best primed local result was `6201.53 QPS`, `0.9507` recall at `14 / 136 / 352`; hot manual local checks reached `6338.30` at `14 / 138 / 416` and `6734.88` at `14 / 136 / 352`.
- Exact fast ANN still trails the kept flat baseline: PQ reached `5107.95 QPS`, `0.9532` at `14 / 138 / 416` and `5272.75`, `0.9525` at `14 / 136 / 352`, versus the flat exact baseline around `5529.23`.

**Next Best Move**

Keep PQ experimental and build on it, not on the older coarse-dim branch. The best next step is to improve PQ exact transfer with a stronger routed signal or cheaper routing/build path, using `measure_ann_search_only --prime-build` as the local culling tool before paying the exact fast gate again.

## Cycle 39

- Reworked that coarse shortlist branch again in `src/db.rs` so it behaves more like a real cluster-local surrogate: each selected range now keeps its own small coarse shortlist before exact `u8` rescoring feeds the global heap, and the coarse vectors now use cluster-specific dimension selections instead of one global top-variance ordering.
- That change materially improved shortlist quality. On the local preload/search-only harness at `14 / 138 / 416`, the old cycle-38 `24 / 1536` point had fallen to about `0.68` recall; the new cluster-local branch moved the same point to about `4344.38 QPS`, `0.9111` recall. A wider local sweep over `dims=24/32` and `coarse_candidates=1536/2048/3072` then reached up to about `4901.25 QPS`, `0.9360` at `32 / 1536` and about `4196.80 QPS`, `0.9491` at `32 / 3072`.
- The branch is still not promotable. Even near-valid points remain well below the flat local baseline, which rechecked at about `6754.04 QPS`, `0.9514` recall with about `202.11 us` scan time. The best cycle-39 coarse point still spent about `520.57 us` in scan time while rescoring about `3102` candidates/query, so the selector/kernel cost still overwhelms the saved full-distance work.
- The important lesson is that the architecture direction is more plausible now even though the current implementation is not fast enough. Cluster-specific coarse signals are clearly stronger than the old global-dimension surrogate. Any next follow-on should attack selector cost directly or switch to an even stronger residual-aware signal, not go back to the old global coarse heap.
- Default scored-path validation stayed official after the ANN-only edits. A fresh serial `run_correctness_test` still passed at `1.0000` recall, and a fresh serial quick `run_benchmark` measured `9431.35 QPS`. Treat that quick score as noise on the default scored path, not as a transport regression signal.
